notes:
SakuraLauncher 0.2.1 beta

- Adds 103 pinned stable Java Edition versions from official provider metadata, including exact Minecraft 1.8.
- Adds bulk installation in Library with download/space preview, real progress, cancellation and explicit resume/retry.
- Adds legacy resource layouts and arguments, Java 17 compatibility for 1.17/1.17.1, and Windows native DLL extraction.
- Preserves existing instances, worlds and profiles. Games are not launched automatically after bulk installation.

Expanded versions remain experimental: resolution is tested for Intel macOS and Windows x64; native startup was checked on Intel macOS for 1.0, 1.6.4, 1.7.2, 1.8 and 1.17.1. This does not certify gameplay for every version. Apple Silicon, public OS code signing and full version-to-version update acceptance remain pending.

The launcher asks before downloading an update. Close active Minecraft sessions before applying it.
